[BEGIN]
module TopModule (
    input  logic clk,
    input  logic a,
    input  logic b,
    output wire  out_assign,
    output logic out_always_comb,
    output logic out_always_ff
);

    assign out_assign = a ^ b;

    always_comb begin
        out_always_comb = a ^ b;
    end

    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        out_always_ff <= a ^ b;
    end

endmodule
[DONE]
